UPDATE: Ukraine Cricket

By: Stenette Grosskopf | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
Three years ago, we shared a story of survival and an extraordinary journey. When Russia declared war on Ukraine, South African cricketer Kobus Olivier was living in Kyiv with his four small dogs. He’d settled there to teach – with the goal of establishing cricket formally in Ukraine. But war brought his plans to a grinding halt – and at the urging of his friends, Kobus joined the crowds of refugees fleeing Ukraine. What followed was a gruelling journey to Zagreb, Croatia, followed by friends all over the world. His story eventually became a documentary.
But the relief didn’t last. Two years ago, Kobus returned to an intensifying war in Kyiv – where his passion for cricket continues to give him purpose.
